name: PR416 final focused validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-final-validation
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-final-validation.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  focused-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run Ball Physics, perception lock, and MatchEngine targets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-final
          dotnet test tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "FullyQualifiedName~TacticalDirector.BallPhysics.Tests|Name=BP007_CoLocatedBall_IsVisibleRegardlessOfFacing|Name=AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed|Name=BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose|Name=TacklesHappenInComposedPlay|Name=ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-final.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-final \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-final/console.log

      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-final-focused-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-final/
          if-no-files-found: error
